title: 第11章 家族审判第12章 愤怒的众人
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: “这便是我林家如今大致的情况，总体来说相比一个月前，我林家的整体实力暴涨了十倍不止……”
林天海的话音缓缓落下。
而听完林天海的讲述，一旁的众人，也是纷纷面露喜色，皆为家族的强大而感到高兴、自豪。
他们相信只要保持这种发展速度，他林家要不了多少年，便会彻底赶上那些老牌准帝族，成为真正的准帝族！
“哈哈哈，如今我林家也算是初步迈入了准帝级势力，只要不出意外，成为媲美天尊山、李家这等老牌的准帝势力，指日可待！”
一位族老大笑道。
“呸，没志气，有轩儿给予的这些至宝，你的眼光居然如此短浅？我林家的目标可是成为帝族！”
“就是就是，没志气！”
闻言其它族老，纷纷反对吐槽。
而此时一旁林天海也是不由自主的开口：
“族老你们小了……”
“……格局小了！”
“要知道什么准帝族、帝族，哪怕是成为天帝强者，不也终究只能局限中州、局限于南冥大陆？”
“但传说中的仙以及仙族呢？他们能活跃于星辰大海，能于活跃于诸天万界，能长生久世，能让势力永垂不朽……”
“所以……为什么这仙，这仙族！我们当不的？我林家当不的？”
“天下势力谁不想成为那万古唯一？天下独尊？在这方面我林家自然不能弱于其它势力！”
林天海慷慨激昂的声音，响彻此地，不断的萦绕于众人耳畔，震人心脾，让人不由得热血沸腾。
而说完反应过来的林天海，却是有些懊恼，暗道：“我这嘴咋就收不住呢，万一老祖觉得我这族长不够稳重，把我给撤了咋办……”
不过林天海却并不觉得自己说错了，因为他有种直觉，他儿子林轩必定会带领林家走上巅峰！
而在林长海懊恼时，作为林家老祖的林长霄三人，却是非常满意的对他夸奖了起来：
“好好好，不愧是我林家族长，格局确实不错！”
“呃，看来当初让小海你来当族长，确实是个明智之举，我林家的族长自然需要有这等远见。”
“小海，二祖果然没看错你！”
就连其它族老也是纷纷调侃起了刚才说话的族老……
“怪不得人家小海是族长呢，你看看你说的什么玩意？天尊山、李家？笑死！哈哈哈！”
“哈哈哈，蛮老头除了肌肉，他还知道个啥！”
“哼！你们比我好的到哪去，你一样是小……格局小！”
“好了，还有何事？没有的话各自回去修炼吧，待老夫巩固下境界，三天后进行家族审判大会！”
只见大祖林长霄越说，脸色越加冷冽。
闻言，众人也是神情严肃，摇了摇头。
而就在众人准备各自离开时，林天海突然想起来，还有一事，当即开口道：“大祖，那不知您突破的消息是否需要传出去？以及是否举办庆祝大典广邀各大势力？”
“暂时不必泄露老夫突破的消息，大典更不必了，如今我林家更应暗中发展，不到逼不得已，尽量隐藏实力，但要展露实力时，也决不能犹豫，不能让其它势力以为我林家好欺负。”
“总之，人不犯我，我不犯人！”
林长霄作为林家老祖，自然知道什么对林家最有利，如今有了鸿蒙神树和洗灵池两大底蕴，他林家缺的是时间，自然不能太过高调，吸引各方势力的注意。
在各方势力还没反应过来之前，尽力积攒实力才是王道。
content_en:
"This is the general situation of our Lin family now. Generally speaking, compared to a month ago, the overall strength of our Lin family has increased by more than ten times..."
Lin Tianhai's voice fell slowly.
After listening to Lin Tianhai's story, everyone on the side also showed joy, and they were all happy and proud of the strength of their family.
They believe that as long as they maintain this pace of development, the Lin family will completely catch up with those veteran quasi-imperial clans and become a true quasi-imperial clan in just a few years!
"Hahaha, our Lin family has now taken the initial step into the quasi-emperor level. As long as nothing happens, we will become a quasi-emperor power comparable to the Tianzun Mountain and Li family. It will be just around the corner!"
A clan elder laughed.
"Bah, you have no ambition. With these treasures given by Xuan'er, your vision is so short-sighted? The goal of my Lin family is to become an imperial clan!"
"It's just that, I have no ambition!"
Hearing this, other clan elders objected and complained.
At this time, Lin Tianhai on the side also said involuntarily:
"Elders, you are too young..."
"...The layout is too small!"
"You have to know the quasi-imperial clan and the imperial clan. Even if they become powerful emperors, won't they be limited to Zhongzhou and Nanming Continent?"
"But what about the legendary immortals and immortal clans? They can be active in the stars and seas, in the heavens and in the world, can live forever, and can make their power immortal..."
"So... why is this immortal, this clan of immortals! Can't we be worthy of it? Can't our Lin family be worthy of it?"
"Who among the forces in the world doesn't want to be the only one in the world? The only one in the world? Naturally, our Lin family cannot be weaker than other forces in this regard!"
Lin Tianhai's impassioned voice resounded throughout the place, lingering in everyone's ears, shaking people's hearts and making people's blood boil.
Lin Tianhai, who reacted after saying this, was a little annoyed and thought to himself: "Why can't I keep my mouth shut? What if the ancestor thinks that I, the leader of the clan, are not stable enough and removes me..."
However, Lin Tianhai did not feel that he was wrong, because he had an intuition that his son Lin Xuan would definitely lead the Lin family to the top!
When Lin Changhai was upset, Lin Changxiao and the other three, as the ancestors of the Lin family, praised him with great satisfaction:
"Okay, okay, you are worthy of being the head of my Lin family. The layout is indeed good!"
"Well, it seems that it was indeed a wise move for you, Xiaohai, to be the clan leader. Naturally, the clan leader of my Lin family needs to have such foresight."
"Xiao Hai, the second ancestor really saw you right!"
Even other clan elders started teasing the clan elder who just spoke...
"No wonder Xiao Hai is the clan leader. Look, what are you talking about? Tianzun Mountain, Li Family? You're laughing so hard! Hahaha!"
"Hahaha, what else does this old man know besides muscles?"
"Hmph! You are no better than me, but you are still small...with a small structure!"
…
"Okay, what else is there? If not, let's go back to practice. After I have consolidated my realm, the family trial will be held in three days!"
Grand Ancestor Lin Changxiao's face became colder and colder as he spoke.
Hearing this, everyone looked serious and shook their heads.
Just when everyone was about to leave, Lin Tianhai suddenly remembered something else and immediately said: "Great Ancestor, do you need to spread the news about your breakthrough? And whether to hold a celebration ceremony to invite all major forces?"
"There is no need to leak the news of my breakthrough for the time being, let alone the grand ceremony. Now our Lin family should develop in secret. We should try our best to hide our strength until we are forced to do so. But when we want to show our strength, we must not hesitate. We cannot let other forces think that my Lin family is easy to bully."
"In short, I won't offend anyone unless they offend me!"
As the ancestor of the Lin family, Lin Changxiao naturally knows what is most beneficial to the Lin family. Now that he has the Hongmeng Sacred Tree and the Spirit Cleansing Pond, what the Lin family lacks is time. Naturally, he cannot be too high-profile to attract the attention of all parties.
Before all forces can react, the best way is to accumulate strength as much as possible.
